title: D115 photographic arguments: grouped challenge subtally
provenance: New explicit grouping of existing recorded outcomes, not recovery of a previously located six-item scoreboard and not six newly adjudicated challenges.
counting_rule: Six topical challenge groups. Several share assumptions and evidence; they are not independent measurements or six main-tally points. Detailed findings retain their exact scope and reopening conditions.

entries.title: Geometric methodology
entries.result: The categorical objections concerning shadow lengths, receiving surfaces and supporting tangents did not defeat the actual projective construction.

entries.title: Known-source validation
entries.result: The claim that validation was only CGI was not sustained: real photographic controls exist. Their reported errors do not establish a universal subdegree error distribution.

entries.title: Developed physical camera/lens alternative
entries.result: The attempted period ultra-wide/shift setup did not establish a historically feasible whole-image fit to mounting, face perspective and thread constraints.

entries.title: Joint calibration and background-tree follow-up
entries.result: The paired-vanishing-point construction preserved a mathematical ambiguity but did not supply the developed scene-consistent alternative needed to sustain the objection.

entries.title: Unknown lens and proposed distortion escape
entries.result: Generic unknown-lens uncertainty did not establish a refutation. The tested small radial distortions did not bridge the angular gap; the conditional tests are not a universal bound on every historical setup.

entries.title: Ordinary sunlight plus cloud/fill-light model
entries.result: The ordinary-lighting model was not sustained as a better explanation of the combined photograph and historical case. Its possible boundary-selection failure mode was not demonstrated as a complete D115 fit.
